terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Welcome to TaskCoper. By using our platform, you agree to comply with the following terms.

accounts.title: 1. User Accounts
accounts.content: You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account and all activities that occur under it. Providing accurate information is mandatory.

management.title: 2. Project & Task Management
management.content: TaskCoper provides tools for managing projects, task cards, and team collaboration. Users are responsible for the content and data they upload.

mentoring.title: 3. Mentoring Services
mentoring.content: The platform connects Experts (Mentors) and Users (Mentees). All agreements regarding meetings and mentoring roadmaps must comply with our professional conduct rules.

payments.title: 4. Payments & Refunds
payments.content: Mentor Packages and transactions on the platform are processed securely. Refunds will be considered based on the specific policy of each package.

ip.title: 5. Intellectual Property
ip.content: All features and designs of TaskCoper are owned by us. Your project content remains yours.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data.

collection.title: 1. Data Collection
collection.content: We collect profile information (name, email, avatar) and activity data (projects, tasks, meeting history) to improve our services.

usage.title: 2. Data Usage
usage.content: Your information is used to operate the platform, support AI advisors, and facilitate connections between Mentors and Mentees.

security.title: 3. Data Security
security.content: We apply standard security measures to prevent unauthorized access or leakage of user data.

rights.title: 4. User Rights
rights.content: You have the right to access, edit, or request deletion of your personal data at any time through account settings.
